verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official MCP server that gives AI assistants its search and reasoning tools. It offers a recommended remote server hosted at https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp and an open-source local stdio server, and lets you restrict which tools are enabled. A separate Computer MCP server lets MCP clients delegate multi-step work, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably in practice.
